name: QR Code Maker
tagline: Turn a link, some text or a Wi-Fi login into a QR code you can print.
seoTitle: Free QR code generator (no sign-up, no expiry)
description: Make QR codes for links, text or Wi-Fi, free and without sign-up. Codes never expire and aren't tracked. Download SVG or PNG.

specs.Tracking: None: the code holds your text directly, not a redirect link
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: Never. Many free QR sites encode a link to their own server so they can track scans or switch the code off later. This one puts your link or text directly in the code.

faq.q: Which error correction should I pick?
faq.a: Medium suits most uses. Choose High if the code will be printed small, on fabric, or with a logo over it.
